question: What post-subagent completion hook contract should OpenClaw support, and what child-output, delivery-status, and announcement mutation authority should plugins get?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but payload fields, privacy boundaries, hook ordering, timeout/error behavior, delivery-result visibility, and mutation/suppression authority are product and security API choices that automation should not freeze.

options.title: Typed bounded plugin hook
options.body: Add a public typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

options.title: Fold into broader lifecycle design
options.body: Hold this specific API until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43454 settles one lifecycle event model across subagents, turns, and thresholds.

options.title: Observation-only event first
options.body: Expose only non-mutating completion observation now and leave announcement suppression or delivery policy to separate work such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13911.

recommendation.title: Typed bounded plugin hook
recommendation.body: Add a public typed hook at the post-child-result/pre-announcement seam with explicit metadata, redaction, timeout, audit, and return semantics for enrichment or suppression.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent thread-binding work and prior review comments make this the strongest product/API routing signal, with plugin-hook contributors still needed for review.
